newsitem.title: CANADA: Canadian dollar opens slightly firmer, range-bound.
newsitem.headline: Canadian dollar opens slightly firmer, range-bound.

text.p: * The Canadian dollar opened slightly firmer at C$1.3962 (US$0.7162) versus the close of C$1.3984 (0.7151). * Dealers said the dollar was steady and trapped in a fairly narrow range with little expected to move the currency until key U.S. labor force data next week. * Canada's unadjusted March consumer price index rose 0.2 percent in the month.
Canada February retail sales rose 1.1 percent seasonally adjusted from January. That was higher than the 0.9 percent economists surveyed by Reuters forecast.

"It's hovering in the upper C$1.39 range, C$1.3950 to C$1.40. I think that's the range we're going to trek up until we get some news on the stance of Fed policy, which will probably have to take us to a week Friday for the labor force survey," Gregory said.
On the crosses, the unit edged up to 1.2223 marks from a close of 1.2139 and to 90.35 yen from 87.61 yen on Monday.
((Sarah Edmonds, Reuters Toronto Bureau (416) 941-8100, E-mail sarah.edmonds@reuters.com))
